title: GET /containers/{id}/stats os_type
body:
### Feature request description

Docker Engine API v1.52 added an `os_type` field to the response of `GET /containers/{id}/stats`. Podman's compat endpoint doesn't return this field yet.

This issue tracks adding `os_type` to the compat stats response (for both streamed and one-shot stats), filled in from the host OS (e.g. `linux`), and adding apiv2 test coverage for it.

Part of #30164 (Compat API v1.52 gaps), under the epic #30159 (claim Docker Engine API v1.55).

Ref: https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v152-api-changes
